operators.semantics: Short-circuit-free boolean and/or/xor over token2bool() results -- this DSL's RPN evaluator resolves both operands before combining.
Numeric arithmetic; '+' is overloaded for string concatenation when either operand is a string.

Reference assignment: the right side is not resolved to a value, it stays a property reference. Assigning a bare property with ':=' creates a live prop-symlink; assigning to self/args/itemModel/parentModel/tentative passes the actual prop_t* into the setter.

Link assignment: always creates a one-way, continuously-live prop_link_ex() link from the right-hand property to the left. The left side may be a bare identifier inside an args/block scope, auto-created as a child prop of the current target.

Normal assignment. If the right side is a property path it is resolved through a live subscription (re-evaluates whenever the underlying prop changes), unless the target attribute is flagged GLW_ATTRIB_FLAG_NO_SUBSCRIPTION (self, itemModel, parentModel, tentative).
Numeric/string comparison via token_cmp()-style helpers; mixed int/float compares by value.
'cond ? a : b': resolves cond via token2bool(), then (unlike '??') does not eagerly resolve both branches -- pushes the unresolved chosen branch.
Conditional assignment: identical to '=', except if the resolved right-hand value is void the assignment is skipped entirely and the left side keeps its previous value.
'a ?? b': resolves a; if a is void, evaluates to b, else to a. Idiom for falling back to a default only when a prop is genuinely unset.
Debug assignment: functionally identical to '=' for the common case; in the direct prop-to-prop link case it passes debug=1 into prop_link_ex(), turning on subscription-debug tracing for that link.

scopes.meaning: Arguments passed in via the args: attribute.
scopes.name: args

scopes.meaning: Scratch root local to one cloner()-generated clone instance.
scopes.name: clone

scopes.meaning: Prop root's absolute global tree; rarely used directly in views.
scopes.name: global

scopes.meaning: The navigator ($nav.currentpage, $nav.pages), wired in via PROP_TAG_NAMED_ROOT.
scopes.name: nav

scopes.meaning: The enclosing scope's self, one level up -- set when a loader/widget block rebinds self.
scopes.name: parent

scopes.meaning: The view root one level up (companion to parent).
scopes.name: parentview

scopes.meaning: The widget/clone's own bound prop (e.g. a page, or the current clone item).
scopes.name: self

scopes.meaning: Global per-glw_root_t UI prop tree ($ui.width, $ui.aspect, $ui.keyboard, $ui.pointerVisible, ...); resolves because the prop node itself is named "ui", not via an explicit named-root tag.
scopes.name: ui

scopes.meaning: Per-view-file scratch root, fresh each time the .view file is loaded.
scopes.name: view
